digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify and External Integration Tests - Pandoc corpus verification
propositions: Gerrit Verify runs complete live-Pandoc corpus replay on every cell and incurs a measured 184-second macOS lower bound that can be reduced without removing any assertion or supported environment.

Committed deterministic Pandoc output artifacts can replace broad corpus assertions in Gerrit Verify while retaining three representative live product-path bodies and all version/platform/argv probes.
A dedicated external pandoc-corpus-replay job running on weekly schedule and manual dispatch must verify every corpus unit and settling pass through real Pandoc on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest.

Static converter and committed fixtures must be fail-closed on unmapped input and platform/version mismatch, deterministic, below repository file-size limits, and validated via a non-writing command path.
